faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the cinematic experience and investment process for your wedding.
faq.q1: Are you available for my date?
faq.a1: I recommend booking 6-12 months in advance, but please inquire for last-minute availability.
faq.q2: Do you travel outside of Helsinki?
faq.a2: Yes, I capture weddings across Finland and worldwide. Travel fees apply for remote locations.
faq.q3: How many images will I receive?
faq.a3: Depending on the package, usually between 400-700 masterfully edited images.
faq.a4: A 'Sneak Peek' is delivered within 48 hours. The full gallery takes 3-4 weeks.
faq.a5: Yes, a 25% non-refundable booking fee is required to secure your date.
